text: PM-Kisan is a farmer support scheme. Source-backed local data says it supports eligible farmer families and requires official verification before application.

text: The local rule checks for a female child within the age threshold and a birth certificate.

text: Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin is a rural sanitation support pathway. Citizens should verify current household and local authority requirements on the official portal.
